text: XXXVIII. 1. Samaggaṃ pana bhante saṅghaṃ bhetvā kiṃ so pasavatī ti? 2. Kappaṭṭhiyaṃ Ānanda kibbisaṃ pasavatī ti. 3. Kiṃ pana bhante kappaṭṭhiyaṃ kibbisan ti? 4. Kappaṃ Ānanda nirayamhi paccatī ti. [page 076] 76 Aṅguttara-Nikāya. XXXVIII.4-XL. 4 Āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho saṅghabhedako vaggarato adhammaṭṭho yogakkhemato dhaṃsaṭi saṅghaṃ samaggaṃ bhetvāna kappaṃ nirayamhi paccatīti.
